climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A US wine state where Pinot Noir and Pinot Gris are the top two grapes harvested. Chardonnay is the most valuable grape overall, while Pinot Noir commands the high end. Its two big AVAs are the Willamette Valley and Southern Oregon, and commercial winemaking began in the 1960s.
